decisions.reason: The spring-balanced desk lamp still draws on the firm's ergonomic office-lighting know-how, but because it is more peripheral to the firm's broader solution-led and intelligent-lighting trajectory it remains a plausible candidate for later portfolio pruning.

The general interior lighting luminaire is tightly aligned with the firm's core indoor-lighting capabilities, channels and learning routines, so management can readily absorb market feedback and refine it commercially.

As a flagship pendant luminaire with microprismatic optics, it is highly consistent with the firm's strategic direction and existing optical and application expertise, making withdrawal very unlikely.

Although marine applications are related to the firm's specialist-lighting base, the HMI searchlight is the least aligned with the firm's LED-, sustainability- and intelligent-lighting knowledge path, so management would reallocate resources away from it.

The marine searchlight remains supported by the firm's certified specialist-lighting and demanding-environment capabilities, though its niche position outside the main building-lighting growth path keeps some withdrawal risk alive.
